title: epack-collector-jumpcloud output
description: The detailed artifact epack-collector-jumpcloud emits at artifacts/jumpcloud.details.json. The collector checks its output against this schema when it emits. A value the collector could not read is left out with a gap in the collector result.

collected_at_level.x-epack-summary: The detail level this artifact was collected at, which is trust, audit, or internal.

org_id.description: The organization's ID from /api/organizations, written from the audit level. Left out, with a gap, when the organization list could not be read, as for a service account
org_id.x-epack-summary: The JumpCloud organization this collection covers.

org_name.description: The organization's displayName from /api/organizations, written from the audit level. Left out, with a gap, when the organization list could not be read, as for a service account, or listed no organization. Left out without a gap when the organization has no display name
org_name.x-epack-summary: The display name of the JumpCloud organization this collection covers.

users.description: Directory user counts by state. When the list was read in part, the counts cover the users read, with a partial gap
users.x-epack-summary: Aggregate user population counts by state.

total.x-epack-method: Counts the users /api/systemusers lists, every page included.

active.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users whose state is ACTIVATED.

staged.x-epack-summary: Users in the STAGED state (not yet activated).
staged.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users whose state is STAGED.

suspended.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users whose state is SUSPENDED.

locked.description: Users whose account is locked, in any state
locked.x-epack-summary: Users whose account is currently locked.
locked.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users whose account_locked flag is true.

partial.description: True when fewer users were read than the totalCount JumpCloud reports. Left out when every one was read.
partial.x-epack-summary: True when fewer users were fetched than JumpCloud reported, so user counts and MFA percentages cover only part of the directory.
partial.x-epack-method: Compares the users read from /api/systemusers with the totalCount JumpCloud reports, and is true when fewer were read.

authentication.description: MFA enrollment across the active users. When the user list was read in part, the values cover the users read, with a partial gap
authentication.x-epack-summary: Multi-factor authentication coverage across the user population.

mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of active users with any MFA method enrolled. Active users are those neither suspended nor staged
mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage of active users with any MFA method enrolled.
mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the active users with an enrolled MFA method by all active users. A user with no mfaEnrollment record counts when totp_enabled is true.

totp_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active users with a TOTP authenticator enrolled
totp_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage of active users with TOTP authenticator enrolled.
totp_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the active users whose mfaEnrollment TOTP status is ENROLLED by all active users. A user with no mfaEnrollment record counts when totp_enabled is true.

webauthn_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active users with a WebAuthn or FIDO2 key enrolled
webauthn_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage of active users with a phishing-resistant WebAuthn or FIDO2 key enrolled.
webauthn_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the active users whose mfaEnrollment WebAuthn status is ENROLLED by all active users.

push_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active users with push MFA enrolled
push_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage of active users with push-based MFA enrolled.
push_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the active users whose mfaEnrollment push status is ENROLLED by all active users.

mfa_not_enrolled_count.description: Active users with no MFA method enrolled
mfa_not_enrolled_count.x-epack-summary: Count of active users with no MFA method enrolled.
mfa_not_enrolled_count.x-epack-method: Counts the active users with no enrolled MFA method.

portal_mfa_required_count.description: Active users whose account requires MFA for the User Portal
portal_mfa_required_count.x-epack-summary: Active users whose account requires MFA to sign in to the JumpCloud User Portal. A requirement does not show which factor they enrolled.
portal_mfa_required_count.x-epack-method: Counts the active users whose enable_user_portal_multifactor flag is true.

admins.description: Admin Portal administrators. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed
admins.x-epack-summary: Admin portal administrator counts, TOTP enrollment, and MFA requirement. Suspended administrators are not counted.

total_admins.description: Admin Portal administrators listed who are not suspended
total_admins.x-epack-summary: Number of JumpCloud admin portal administrators who are not suspended.
total_admins.x-epack-method: Counts the administrators /api/users lists whose suspended flag is false, every page included.

super_admin_count.description: Administrators with the Administrator With Billing role who are not suspended
super_admin_count.x-epack-summary: Administrators with the Administrator With Billing role, the highest JumpCloud privilege. Suspended administrators are not counted.
super_admin_count.x-epack-method: Counts the administrators who are not suspended and whose roleName is Administrator With Billing.

totp_enrolled_count.description: Administrators who are not suspended and have TOTP enrolled. JumpCloud reports no other administrator factor
totp_enrolled_count.x-epack-summary: Administrators who are not suspended and have an authenticator app (TOTP) enrolled. Other factors, such as security keys, are not reported by JumpCloud.
totp_enrolled_count.x-epack-method: Counts the administrators who are not suspended and whose totpEnrolled flag is true.

totp_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of the administrators who are not suspended that have TOTP enrolled. Null when there are none
totp_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of administrators with an authenticator app (TOTP) enrolled, among those who are not suspended. Admins without it may still use another factor.
totp_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the administrators with TOTP enrolled by all administrators who are not suspended.

mfa_required_count.description: Administrators who are not suspended and whose account requires MFA at sign-in
mfa_required_count.x-epack-summary: Administrators who are not suspended and whose account requires MFA at sign-in. A requirement does not show which factor they enrolled.
mfa_required_count.x-epack-method: Counts the administrators who are not suspended and whose enableMultiFactor flag is true.

partial.description: True when fewer administrators were read than the totalCount JumpCloud reports. Left out when every one was read.
partial.x-epack-summary: True when fewer administrators were fetched than JumpCloud reported, so administrator counts cover only part of the list.
partial.x-epack-method: Compares the administrators read from /api/users with the totalCount JumpCloud reports, and is true when fewer were read.

apps.description: Applications in the application list. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed

total_apps.description: Applications listed, with or without an SSO type
total_apps.x-epack-summary: Applications in JumpCloud's application list, with or without SSO set up.
total_apps.x-epack-method: Counts the applications /api/applications lists, every page included.

sso_enabled_apps.description: Applications with an SSO type set
sso_enabled_apps.x-epack-summary: Applications with an SSO type set up.
sso_enabled_apps.x-epack-method: Counts the applications that have an SSO type set.

sso_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of applications with an SSO type set. Null when there are no applications
sso_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Percentage of applications with an SSO type set up.
sso_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the applications with an SSO type by all applications.

partial.description: True when fewer applications were read than the totalCount JumpCloud reports. Left out when every one was read.
partial.x-epack-summary: True when fewer applications were fetched than JumpCloud reported, so application counts and SSO coverage cover only part of the list.
partial.x-epack-method: Compares the applications read from /api/applications with the totalCount JumpCloud reports, and is true when fewer were read.

policies.description: Authentication policy configuration. Left out, with a gap, when the policies could not be listed
policies.x-epack-summary: Summary of conditional access and authentication policies.

total_policies.description: Authentication policies listed, enabled or not
total_policies.x-epack-method: Counts the authentication policies /api/v2/authn/policies lists, enabled or not.

mfa_required_policies.x-epack-method: Counts the enabled policies whose effect requires MFA.

has_mfa_required_policy.description: Whether any enabled policy requires MFA. It does not show which users or sign-ins the policy covers
has_mfa_required_policy.x-epack-summary: Whether at least one enabled policy requires MFA. The policy may cover only some users or sign-ins.
has_mfa_required_policy.x-epack-method: Checks whether any enabled policy's effect requires MFA.

has_device_managed_condition.description: Whether any enabled policy has a managed-device condition
has_device_managed_condition.x-epack-summary: Whether at least one enabled policy has a managed-device condition. The condition may apply to only some sign-ins.
has_device_managed_condition.x-epack-method: Checks whether any enabled policy has a deviceManaged condition anywhere in its condition tree.

has_phishing_resistant_admin_policy.description: Whether an enabled Admin Portal policy requires MFA and allows only WebAuthn or FIDO2 factors
has_phishing_resistant_admin_policy.x-epack-summary: Whether an enabled Admin Portal policy requires MFA and allows only WebAuthn or FIDO2 keys. The policy may cover only some administrators.
has_phishing_resistant_admin_policy.x-epack-method: Checks whether an enabled admin_portal policy requires MFA and lists only WEBAUTHN or FIDO2 factors.

devices.description: Managed systems. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be listed

total_systems.description: Distinct systems listed, one per device ID
total_systems.x-epack-summary: Managed systems, counted once per device ID.
total_systems.x-epack-method: Counts the distinct device IDs /api/systems lists, every page included.

active_systems.description: Systems whose active flag is true
active_systems.x-epack-method: Counts the listed systems whose active flag is true. A system listed more than once counts once.

mdm_enrolled.description: Systems with evidence of MDM enrollment
mdm_enrolled.x-epack-summary: Systems with evidence of MDM enrollment, through JumpCloud or another MDM.
mdm_enrolled.x-epack-method: Counts the listed systems with an internal or external MDM vendor, or with an MDM device ID. A system listed more than once counts once.

os_breakdown.description: Systems by operating system, grouped into macOS, Windows, and Linux where the OS name matches
os_breakdown.x-epack-summary: System count by operating system family.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Systems whose operating system falls under this name.
additionalProperties.x-epack-method: Counts the listed systems by OS name, grouped into macOS, Windows, and Linux where the name matches. A system listed more than once counts once.

partial.description: True when fewer distinct systems were read than the totalCount JumpCloud reports. Left out when every one was read.
partial.x-epack-summary: True when fewer distinct devices were fetched than JumpCloud reported, so device counts cover only part of the fleet.
partial.x-epack-method: Compares the distinct device IDs read from /api/systems with the totalCount JumpCloud reports, and is true when fewer were read.

device_controls.description: Encryption, firewall, and antimalware readings across the fleet, with the device counts behind each percentage. The same figures appear in the endpoint-posture artifact. Left out, with a gap, when the systems could not be listed
device_controls.x-epack-summary: Encryption, firewall, and antimalware readings across the fleet. Each control gives its share beside the device counts behind it, so a share from a few readable devices is not mistaken for the whole fleet.

discovery_complete.description: Whether every device JumpCloud reports was listed. When false or null, the control summaries are left out. Null when the systems list leaves it unknown
discovery_complete.x-epack-summary: Whether every device JumpCloud reported was fetched. When incomplete or unknown, the per-control figures are left out.
discovery_complete.x-epack-method: Checks that the distinct device IDs listed number at least the totalCount JumpCloud reports for /api/systems. A list the collector's row limit stopped gives false, and a list that ends early or repeats a device gives null.

max_observation_age_seconds.description: How old, in seconds, a device reading may be and still count
max_observation_age_seconds.x-epack-summary: How old, in seconds, a device reading may be and still count. Older readings count as unknown.
max_observation_age_seconds.x-epack-method: Takes the max_observation_age_hours config value in seconds, which is 604800 by default.

disk_encryption.description: The disk encryption control across the fleet. Left out, with a gap, when a System Insights table it needs could not be read in full, or when device discovery was incomplete
disk_encryption.x-epack-summary: Disk encryption across the fleet, with the device counts behind the share.

passing_pct.description: Percentage of the devices whose disk encryption reading passed, out of those whose reading passed or failed. Null when no device's reading passed or failed
passing_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of evaluated devices with full-disk encryption on. On Windows, every BitLocker volume must be fully encrypted with protection on, and devices with no usable reading are left out of the share.
passing_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the devices whose disk encryption reading passed by the devices whose reading passed or failed. Windows readings come from System Insights bitlocker_info, and other systems' readings from the agent's fde.active flag.
passing_pct.x-epack-null: No device's reading passed or failed.

passing_devices_count.description: Devices whose disk encryption reading passed
passing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that passes.
passing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose disk encryption reading passed.

failing_devices_count.description: Devices whose disk encryption reading failed
failing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that fails.
failing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose disk encryption reading failed.

unknown_devices_count.description: Devices with no usable disk encryption reading
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with no usable reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or conflicting. They count as neither passing nor failing.
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices with no usable disk encryption reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or unrecognized.

not_applicable_devices_count.description: Devices the disk encryption control does not apply to
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices this control does not apply to.
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices the disk encryption control does not apply to.

firewall.description: The firewall control across the fleet. Left out, with a gap, when a System Insights table it needs could not be read in full, or when device discovery was incomplete
firewall.x-epack-summary: Firewall across the fleet, with the device counts behind the share.

passing_pct.description: Percentage of the devices whose firewall reading passed, out of those whose reading passed or failed. Null when no device's reading passed or failed
passing_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of evaluated devices with the host firewall turned on. Devices with no usable reading are left out of the share and counted as unknown.
passing_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the devices whose firewall reading passed by the devices whose reading passed or failed. macOS readings come from System Insights alf, and Windows readings from windows_security_center.
passing_pct.x-epack-null: No device's reading passed or failed.

passing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that passes.
passing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose firewall reading passed.

failing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that fails.
failing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose firewall reading failed.

unknown_devices_count.description: Devices with no usable firewall reading
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with no usable reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or conflicting. They count as neither passing nor failing.
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices with no usable firewall reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or unrecognized.

not_applicable_devices_count.description: Devices the firewall control does not apply to
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices this control does not apply to.
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices the firewall control does not apply to.

antimalware_installed.description: The antimalware installed control across the fleet. Left out, with a gap, when a System Insights table it needs could not be read in full, or when device discovery was incomplete
antimalware_installed.x-epack-summary: Antimalware installed across the fleet, with the device counts behind the share.

passing_pct.description: Percentage of the devices whose antimalware installed reading passed, out of those whose reading passed or failed. Null when no device's reading passed or failed
passing_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of evaluated Windows devices with an antivirus product registered. Devices with no usable reading are left out of the share and counted as unknown.
passing_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the devices whose antimalware installed reading passed by the devices whose reading passed or failed. Readings come from System Insights windows_security_products, on Windows only.
passing_pct.x-epack-null: No device's reading passed or failed.

passing_devices_count.description: Devices whose antimalware installed reading passed
passing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that passes.
passing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose antimalware installed reading passed.

failing_devices_count.description: Devices whose antimalware installed reading failed
failing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that fails.
failing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose antimalware installed reading failed.

unknown_devices_count.description: Devices with no usable antimalware installed reading
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with no usable reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or conflicting. They count as neither passing nor failing.
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices with no usable antimalware installed reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or unrecognized.

not_applicable_devices_count.description: Devices the antimalware installed control does not apply to
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices this control does not apply to.
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices the antimalware installed control does not apply to.

antimalware_healthy.description: The antimalware healthy control across the fleet. Left out, with a gap, when a System Insights table it needs could not be read in full, or when device discovery was incomplete
antimalware_healthy.x-epack-summary: Antimalware healthy across the fleet, with the device counts behind the share.

passing_pct.description: Percentage of the devices whose antimalware healthy reading passed, out of those whose reading passed or failed. Null when no device's reading passed or failed
passing_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of evaluated Windows devices with antivirus on and signatures current. Devices with no usable reading are left out of the share and counted as unknown.
passing_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the devices whose antimalware healthy reading passed by the devices whose reading passed or failed. Readings come from System Insights windows_security_products, on Windows only.
passing_pct.x-epack-null: No device's reading passed or failed.

passing_devices_count.description: Devices whose antimalware healthy reading passed
passing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that passes.
passing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose antimalware healthy reading passed.

failing_devices_count.description: Devices whose antimalware healthy reading failed
failing_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with a current reading that fails.
failing_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices whose antimalware healthy reading failed.

unknown_devices_count.description: Devices with no usable antimalware healthy reading
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices with no usable reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or conflicting. They count as neither passing nor failing.
unknown_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices with no usable antimalware healthy reading, such as one that is stale, missing, or unrecognized.

not_applicable_devices_count.description: Devices the antimalware healthy control does not apply to
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-summary: Devices this control does not apply to.
not_applicable_devices_count.x-epack-method: Counts the devices the antimalware healthy control does not apply to.

user_inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-user detail with state and MFA enrollment.

per_user.description: One row per directory user. The rows stop at 20,000, with a partial gap
per_user.x-epack-summary: One row per directory user, with account state and MFA enrollment.

state.description: Account state, such as ACTIVATED, STAGED, or SUSPENDED
state.x-epack-summary: Account state, such as ACTIVATED, STAGED, or SUSPENDED.

mfa_enrolled.description: Whether the user has any MFA method enrolled
mfa_enrolled.x-epack-summary: Whether this user has any MFA method enrolled.

totp_enabled.description: Whether the user has a TOTP authenticator enrolled
totp_enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether a TOTP authenticator is enrolled.

webauthn_enabled.description: Whether the user has a WebAuthn or FIDO2 key enrolled
webauthn_enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether a phishing-resistant WebAuthn/FIDO2 key is enrolled.

account_locked.x-epack-summary: Whether the account is currently locked.

created.x-epack-summary: When the user was created in JumpCloud.

truncated.description: True when the rows stopped at 20,000. Left out otherwise
truncated.x-epack-summary: True if the per-user rows stopped at the 20,000-row cap. Counts and percentages still cover every fetched user.

truncated_dropped.description: User rows the 20,000-row limit left out
truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: How many user rows the 20,000-row cap left out.

app_inventory.description: Per-application detail. Left out, with a gap, when the applications could not be listed

per_app.x-epack-summary: One row per JumpCloud application, with its SSO type.

sso_type.x-epack-summary: The application's SSO protocol, such as SAML or OIDC.

sso_enabled.description: Whether the application has an SSO type set
sso_enabled.x-epack-summary: Whether this application has an SSO type configured in JumpCloud.

group_inventory.x-epack-summary: User and device groups defined in JumpCloud.

user_groups.description: User groups. Null, with a gap, when they could not be listed

system_groups.x-epack-summary: Groups of devices that policies and access apply to.

per_device.description: One row per system record. The rows stop at 20,000, with a partial gap
per_device.x-epack-summary: One row per device, with its OS, agent, and MDM enrollment.

active.x-epack-summary: Whether the system is currently active.

agent_version.x-epack-summary: Version of the JumpCloud agent installed on the device.

mdm_enrolled.description: Whether the system shows evidence of MDM enrollment
mdm_enrolled.x-epack-summary: Whether this device shows evidence of MDM enrollment, through JumpCloud or another MDM.

controls.description: The device's reading for each control
controls.x-epack-summary: This device's reading for each control.

disk_encryption.description: This device's disk encryption reading. Left out, with a gap, when a System Insights table it needs could not be read in full
disk_encryption.x-epack-summary: This device's disk encryption reading and when it was observed.

state.description: The device's disk encryption reading. Unknown means no usable reading
state.x-epack-summary: This device's disk encryption reading, which is pass, fail, unknown, or not applicable. Unknown means no usable reading.

observed_at.description: When the device reported the reading. Absent when the source gives no time

antimalware_healthy.x-epack-summary: This device's antimalware healthy reading and when it was observed.

state.description: The device's antimalware healthy reading. Unknown means no usable reading

observed_at.x-epack-summary: When the device reported this reading. Absent when the source gives no time.

truncated.description: True when the rows stopped at 20,000. Left out otherwise

truncated_dropped.description: Device rows the 20,000-row limit left out
truncated_dropped.x-epack-summary: How many device rows the 20,000-row cap left out.

type.x-epack-summary: What sign-in the policy governs, such as the User Portal, Admin Portal, or SSO applications.

disabled.x-epack-summary: Whether the policy is turned off.

mfa_required.x-epack-summary: Whether the policy requires MFA when it applies.

allowed_factors.description: The MFA factors the policy accepts. Absent when it accepts any factor
allowed_factors.x-epack-summary: MFA factors the policy accepts. Absent when any factor is accepted.

device_managed.description: Whether the policy has a deviceManaged condition
device_managed.x-epack-summary: Whether the policy has a condition on the device being managed by JumpCloud.

audit_log.description: Directory Insights events from the last seven days. Left out, with a gap, when they could not be read
audit_log.x-epack-summary: Recent Directory Insights events, such as sign-ins and administrative changes.

window_days.description: How many days of events were requested
window_days.x-epack-summary: How many days of events were requested.

count_by_type.x-epack-summary: Event counts by Directory Insights event type, over the events fetched. Not a complete total when the event list was capped.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Events of this type among the events read.

events.x-epack-summary: One row per Directory Insights event.

actor.x-epack-summary: Email of the person or account that initiated the event, when JumpCloud reports one.
